The path defines four points: (78.01,21.13), (69.60,22.72), (77.07,62.39), (85.49,60.81), then back to the first point.  
Four points connected sequentially form a quadrilateral.  
Checking side lengths:  
- Between first two points: horizontal difference ~8.41, vertical difference ~1.59 → not equal sides.  
- Adjacent sides differ in length, but two pairs of adjacent sides appear equal:  
  (78.01,21.13)→(69.60,22.72) length ≈ √(8.41² + 1.59²) ≈ 8.56  
  (85.49,60.81)→(78.01,21.13) length ≈ √(7.48² + 39.68²) ≈ 40.38  
  (69.60,22.72)→(77.07,62.39) length ≈ √(7.47² + 39.67²) ≈ 40.37  
  (77.07,62.39)→(85.49,60.81) length ≈ √(8.42² + 1.58²) ≈ 8.57  
So two distinct adjacent pairs have equal lengths, which is the property of a kite.  
Not a rectangle or trapezoid because no parallel sides.  

Final answer: (D)
